facts.text: Sir Alfred, the undead knight in Sir Brandon's tomb, was left incapacitated but not destroyed and may recover and attack the party if they return to the Barrow Mound.
Sir Alfred may recover and kill more Free Goblin Society members, who plan to live in the mound's church, antechamber and statue room behind a wall over the stairs.
Why does Sir Alfred, the undead knight whom Brother Dirk regards as holy, roam the Barrow Mound?
